Specific Heat of Water

Chemistry H · Period 3 · Jordan Kim, Aisha Patel

Purpose

To determine the specific heat capacity of water by adding a measured amount of energy to 200.0 g of water and recording the change in temperature.

Data

MeasurementValue
Mass of water200.0 g
Energy added8,180 J
Initial temperature21.4 °C
Final temperature31.4 °C

Results

Using q = mcΔT, we calculated c = 4.09 J/g·°C, about 2.2% below the accepted value of 4.18 J/g·°C. Most of the error likely comes from heat lost to the beaker and the surrounding air.

How it works

An evening with Oasis.

  1. 3:45 PM

    You get home. Pip's sitting in the notch with a little 3 next to him.

    That's what's due by tomorrow. Nothing pops up while you're at school.

  2. 4:10 PM

    You click him, and your whole afternoon unfolds.

    Homework from Canvas, your to-dos and what's playing, in one glance. Click away and it tucks back in.

  3. 5:30 PM

    You start a focus round. YouTube tries to sneak in and closes itself.

    You keep your streak and earn points toward a break you actually picked.

  4. 7:00 PM

    Pip drops down: the lab report is due at 8:30 tomorrow.

    You tap Done when it's finished. If you forget, he'll ask again later. Never after bedtime.

Focus and privacy

Keeps you on task. Keeps your stuff yours.

Distracting tabs close themselves.

Start a focus round and Oasis keeps an eye on your browser. Open YouTube, Instagram or TikTok and the tab closes on its own, Pip drops a quick note, and it costs you 3 points. Stay on track and you earn points toward rewards you pick.

YouTubeInstagramTikTokXRedditFacebookSnapchatTwitchNetflix+ your own

Works in Chrome, Safari, Arc, Brave and Edge. Breaks unblock everything until the next round starts.

Studying one thing? Focus on just that.

Under "Or focus on", pick a task and only its sites stay open. Every other website tab closes, and apps that aren't on the list are hidden (never quit), each for 3 points. SAT Math keeps College Board and Bluebook, Khan Academy, Desmos, Wolfram Alpha and Mathway, plus Calculator, Grapher and Preview.

SAT MathSAT ReadingEssay writingHomeworkCoding+ Task

With + Task, say what you're working on (like "AP Bio flashcards") and your own AI key picks the sites and apps. No key? Type the sites yourself. Sign-in pages, Canvas and new tabs always work.

Sharing your screen? Press ⌃⌥H first.

Private mode keeps Oasis out of screenshots, and when you share or record, it shrinks to Pip and the time until your next deadline, so your homework and names never end up on everyone else's screen.

Presenting? Your script floats right on top.

Write your talking points in the Meetings tab, then float them in a see-through window over whatever you're presenting. Oasis records the call and writes down what's said. Share just the tab you're presenting, and the other person sees your work, not your notes.

Make it yours

The most customizable productivity app you'll use.

No two students have the same week. Oasis bends to yours, so it fits what you actually do instead of making you fit it.

Reminders
Any time before a deadline, down to the minute (42 minutes? sure), plus your own snooze length, nudges and sounds.
Your day
Quiet hours for school and sleep, and the evening time Pip gives you a heads-up.
Home screen
Pick which tiles show up, make them bigger or smaller, and drag them into your order.
Focus
Which sites get closed, how long a session lasts, and Pomodoro rounds and breaks that fit how you work.
Rewards
Make your own rewards and set what each one costs in points.
Look
Any accent color, the text size you like, and Pip in seven colors.
Mode
School mode with Canvas and ECs, or Work mode with just your to-dos and focus.
Little things
Battery nudges, a menu bar icon, a quick-add shortcut, and private mode on the key you pick.

Get Oasis for your notch.

Free, and ready now. Download it, give it one quick approval, and Pip takes it from there.

Got Oasis 1.0 or 1.1? Those first versions can't update themselves. Download Oasis again below and drag it into Applications to replace the old one. After that, Oasis keeps itself up to date.
Download for MacRelease notes and .dmg
Version 1.72 MBFreemacOS 14 or laterApple silicon
  1. 1Open Oasis.zip from your Downloads, then drag Oasis into Applications.
  2. 2Open Oasis. Your Mac says it couldn't verify the app, because Oasis isn't from the App Store. Click Done.
  3. 3Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down, and click Open Anyway next to Oasis.
  4. 4Open Oasis again and click Open. You only do this once. Pip walks you through the rest.

You only do the Open Anyway step once. After that, Oasis keeps itself up to date: when a new version is out, it asks you to update, and it takes about 10 seconds.
